metadata.case_name: HUNG CHOR HUNG JOHN v. LI KWOK KIN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: He resigned from his job to look after both families

injuries.description: On 16 July 2007, Madam Chow So Hing (“Deceased”) was fatally injured in a traffic accident.
source: On 16 July 2007, Madam Chow So Hing (“Deceased”) was fatally injured in a traffic accident.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: the Deceased devoted her time to look after her family, her younger sister and the Niece. After her sons got married and had children, she looked after her grandchildren and the Niece by doing housework and preparing meals for them for about 16 hours per day.
living together with the 1st Son’s family brought disputes and disharmony.

losses.category: Loss of ability to pursue education
losses.description: the Niece whose father had died returned to live with her mother who was a working parent, so she was not so well looked after as before, and her school grades slipped.
